recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Ranch Protein Pizzas (Meal Prep, 8)

items.i: self-raising flour (or plain flour + 2 tsp baking powder)
Frank's RedHot Buffalo sauce (70 g per pizza)
light grated mozzarella (80 g per pizza)
extra Buffalo sauce (45 ml per pizza)

steps: Season the chicken with salt, garlic and onion powder, Italian herbs and smoked paprika. Spray with oil and air fry at 200°C/400°F for 12–14 minutes (or oven bake 15–18 minutes).
Mix the flour, yogurt, blended nutritional yeast and seasonings until crumbly, then knead into a ball. If it's sticky, add flour a little at a time until workable.
Divide into 8, roll each thin and wide on a floured surface, fold the edges over to form a crust and move to lined trays.
Spread 70 g Buffalo sauce on each base, then add the chicken, 80 g cheese, red onion and jalapeño.
Spray the crusts with oil and bake at 185°C/365°F for about 15 minutes until crispy, in 2–3 batches if needed.
Drizzle with extra Buffalo sauce and light ranch.
Freeze once cooled; reheat in the air fryer or oven at 200°C/400°F for about 7 minutes.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per pizza (8 total); the full amounts are from the recipe he messaged you. Amount of flour needed varies with how wet your yogurt is.
